title: Chapter 2 — Stage 0 Rulings
lede: Fifteen decisions remain after safe name corrections. This is a prep-less historical backfill, so the later chapter document is corroboration rather than session-local authority.
footer: Applied without asking: 3 mechanical correction groups in gm-assist.md — Brewbarry, Toblen Stonehill, and Dazlyn Grayshard. No contemporaneous prep existed; chapter_02 spans this session and the following two sessions.

items.t: Correct the recap's conflation of Soma and Valphine Sotorra.
items.y: Rewrite gm-assist.md:10, :64, and :67 so Soma is the Tortle druid guide and Valphine Sotorra is the Drow cleric of Lathander.
items.n: Leave Balfine Satora identified as the Tortle and leave the Drow unnamed, preserving a party-identity error in gm-assist.md.
items.ev: For correction: docs/chapters/chapter_02_arrival_in_phandalin.md:51 names Valphine and :77 names Soma as the Tortle guide. Caution: the contemporaneous ASR renders “Balfine Satora” at session_2025_05_14_chapter_2_transcript.speakers.vtt:1187 and “Balfine” again at :1431, so that form may be either an early working name or repeated ASR drift.

items.t: Make the party's joining sequence explicit.
items.y: Revise gm-assist.md:10 to say Valphine traveled out of Neverwinter with Vukradin and Brewbarry, and they met Soma outside the city when she offered to guide them to Phandalin.
items.n: Keep the generic joining language; the recap will identify the four PCs after finding s0-02 but will not assert a precise joining sequence.
items.ev: The post-hoc chapter places Valphine on the road at docs/chapters/chapter_02_arrival_in_phandalin.md:51 and the meeting with Soma at :77. That chapter spans three sessions, so this chronology is strong corroboration but not contemporaneous prep.

items.t: Remove Bramgrim from the piano-bar exchange.
items.y: Split the block at gm-assist.md:46 into Vukradin's “I drink at the bar. I play piano.” and Gary's “I drink tea.” as table banter, removing the nonexistent Bramgrim attribution.
items.n: Leave the combined quote attributed to Bramgrim, a character who was not in this party.
items.ev: Dave says the piano-bar lines at session_2025_05_14_chapter_2_transcript.speakers.vtt:1835; Gary says “I drink tea” at :1847. Gary voiced both Valphine and Brewbarry, so the VTT cannot safely assign that joke to one of his PCs.

items.t: Remove Bramgrim from the 'We did it' exchange.
items.y: Split gm-assist.md:51 into Soma saying “We did it … Let's go get our money,” with Vukradin interjecting “Let's go.”
items.n: Leave the spliced multi-speaker quote attributed to Bramgrim.
items.ev: Wade/Soma says “We did it” and “Let's go get our money” at session_2025_05_14_chapter_2_transcript.speakers.vtt:6107 and :6115; Dave/Vukradin supplies “Let's go” at :6111.

items.t: Split the sending-stone quote between the GM's dwarf and Vukradin.
items.y: Replace the combined Bramgrim quote at gm-assist.md:37 with the dwarf/GM saying magical items are valuable and Vukradin replying, “I'm not sure about that.”
items.n: Keep two speakers' dialogue fused into one quote and attributed to Bramgrim.
items.ev: The GM speaks the first sentence at session_2025_05_14_chapter_2_transcript.speakers.vtt:6887; Dave/Vukradin replies at :6891.

items.t: Record Vukradin's final impression that Toblen adored his music.
items.y: Revise gm-assist.md:16 and the memorable moment at :42–:44 to say Vukradin believed Toblen adored the performance, whether or not that belief was accurate.
items.n: Keep saying Vukradin remained unsure, contradicting the GM's final restatement of the Insight result.
items.ev: After revising the low-Insight narration, the GM says, “You got the impression that he adored your music” at session_2025_05_14_chapter_2_transcript.speakers.vtt:4271.

items.t: Clarify that 50 gp was the selected Dwarven Excavation reward, not a blanket rate.
items.y: Keep the accurate selected-quest sentence at gm-assist.md:18, but narrow :99 and :138 to the Dwarven Excavation reward instead of implying every posted task paid 50 gp.
items.n: Leave the scene and Harbin entry broad enough to imply one 50 gp rate across the quest board.
items.ev: The table reviews three separate quests at session_2025_05_14_chapter_2_transcript.speakers.vtt:4803–:4863, explicitly compares higher and lower pay at :4891–:4899, and selects the dwarf prospectors.

items.t: Credit Dazlyn with the temple-history explanation.
items.y: Change gm-assist.md:20 and Norbus's entry at :144 so Dazlyn gives the Abbathor, earthquake, and avalanche explanation; retain the joint phrasing already used at :114.
items.n: Keep the historical explanation primarily attributed to Norbus.
items.ev: The GM identifies Dazlyn as confirming the Religion result at session_2025_05_14_chapter_2_transcript.speakers.vtt:6287, immediately before the earthquake-and-avalanche explanation at :6291.

items.t: Correct who led the party into the temple.
items.y: Revise gm-assist.md:22 and :120 so Soma takes the front in the marching order and Vukradin later enters the secret passage first.
items.n: Keep Brewbarry credited with Soma's “toughest / nothing to lose / late in life” rationale.
items.ev: Wade/Soma claims the front and that rationale at session_2025_05_14_chapter_2_transcript.speakers.vtt:5839–:5847 and confirms “It'll be me up front” at :7099; Dave/Vukradin volunteers for the passage at cue 1837.

items.y: Rewrite gm-assist.md:22 and :121 so Valphine's passive Perception reveals the foyer secret door immediately, followed later by a second secret door at the passage's end.
items.n: Keep the recap's compressed sequence, which obscures Valphine's discovery and merges two doors.
items.ev: The group establishes Valphine's passive Perception at session_2025_05_14_chapter_2_transcript.speakers.vtt:7099–:7115; the GM reveals the first secret door at :7223; the later door appears at :7655.

items.t: Change the overhead dragon from an observed condition to a regional report.
items.y: Replace “a white dragon circling somewhere overhead” at gm-assist.md:24 with “reports of a white dragon somewhere in the region.”
items.n: Leave the recap implying the party observed a dragon over the excavation.
items.ev: Toblen reports a dragon problem at session_2025_05_14_chapter_2_transcript.speakers.vtt:4719; Wade refers to stories of a white dragon at :5743. No excavation-site sighting occurs in the session record.

items.t: Frame the ochre jelly as the prospectors' warning, not the party's observation.
items.y: Replace “an ochre jelly somewhere deeper in the shadows” at gm-assist.md:24 with “the prospectors' warning of an ochre jelly somewhere inside.”
items.n: Keep the more definite atmospheric phrasing even though the party had not located the jelly.
items.ev: Norbus introduces what the prospectors discovered at session_2025_05_14_chapter_2_transcript.speakers.vtt:7247; the GM reports that they saw and fled an ochre jelly at :7259–:7263.

items.t: Correct Dazlyn's role from helping clear the ruins to hiring the party.
items.y: Change gm-assist.md:141 to say Dazlyn hired the party to deal with the dangerous creatures rather than agreeing to accompany them.
items.n: Leave the NPC entry implying Dazlyn personally joined the clearing effort.
items.ev: The prospectors present a business proposition and offer stones if the party deals with the creatures at session_2025_05_14_chapter_2_transcript.speakers.vtt:6815–:6855; they do not join the temple entry.

items.t: Make the sending-stone offer jointly attributable to the prospectors.
items.y: Change Norbus's entry at gm-assist.md:144 to say the two prospectors offered the sending stones together, matching the recap's safer collective wording.
items.n: Keep the offer assigned solely to Norbus despite unstable speaker assignment; later campaign state instead assigns it to Dazlyn.
items.ev: The transcript introduces Dazlyn and Norbus collectively at session_2025_05_14_chapter_2_transcript.speakers.vtt:6815, then uses an unidentified “he” for the offer. This makes collective attribution safer than choosing either dwarf.

items.t: Record that Soma prepared Goodberry rather than merely considering it.
items.y: Revise gm-assist.md:180 to say Soma prepared Goodberry for wilderness nourishment, considering Longstrider or Ice Knife as the spell to drop.
items.n: Keep the conservative wording that the spell was only considered.
items.ev: An uncertain speaker says “I could prepare Goodberries” and “I'll take off … Longstrider” at session_2025_05_14_chapter_2_transcript.speakers.vtt:5255–:5263; Wade/Soma then says Ice Knife will never be used at :5267.
